preparation_checklist: Bring a valid photo ID every day — required at Interchange pantries (Village Church and St. Mark AME) and Jewish Community Pantry.
Call The Gathering (414-272-4122) before your first visit to confirm walk-in policy.
Call SVdP Harambee Kitchen (414-249-3866) and Cross Roads Kitchen (414-649-9555) to confirm cost and walk-in access.
Call Capuchin House of Peace (414-933-1300) to confirm current hours before visiting — last checked Aug 2024.
Call Maccanon Brown (414-404-0600) to confirm they serve 53206 and to verify hours before Tue/Fri visits.
Call COA Goldin Center (414-265-7696) before Sat Sep 12 visit — service area and hours unconfirmed.
At every pantry, ask specifically for no-cook or ready-to-eat items — you have no kitchen.
Saturday dinner (Sep 12) and Sunday breakfast/lunch (Sep 13) have no confirmed service — plan to use pantry items picked up earlier in the week.

Pantries fill gaps for take-home food. res-003 (paid mobile market) is excluded. All sources are free or cost-unknown; call ahead to confirm cost-unknown sites before visiting.
